name: Epoetin beta
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Anemia of chronic kidney failure, correction (SC)
usual_adult_dose.dose: 20 IU/kg three times weekly; increase by 20 IU/kg three times weekly every 4 weeks if needed; maximum 720 IU/kg/week

usual_adult_dose.indication: Anemia of chronic kidney failure, correction (IV)
usual_adult_dose.dose: 40 IU/kg three times weekly; after 4 weeks 80 IU/kg three times weekly, then 20 IU/kg increments monthly; maximum 720 IU/kg/week
Halve the correction dose, then adjust every 1 to 2 weeks to Hb 10 to 12 g/dL; SC once weekly or every 2 weeks when stable

key_interactions.effect: Higher Hb can increase circuit clotting.
key_interactions.action: Heparin dose may need to rise.

serious: Stroke, cardiovascular events and death at high Hb targets

contraindications: Multidose formulation (benzyl alcohol): children under 3 years

pk.half_life: IV 4 to 12 hours; SC 13 to 28 hours

sources.citation: European Medicines Agency. (2023). NeoRecormon (epoetin beta): EPAR product information [Summary of product characteristics; last updated March 15, 2023]. Roche Registration GmbH.
